description:
A beautifully presented garden-level studio apartment ideally positioned in the heart of Dublin 4. This bright and well-designed home offers stylish, modern living in one of Dublin`s most sought-after residential locations.

The accommodation has been thoughtfully laid out to maximise both space and functionality, featuring a contemporary Murphy bed that effortlessly transforms the living area, a sleek, fully fitted modern kitchen, and a stylish, fully tiled bathroom finished to a high standard. Large French doors open directly onto a private patio area, creating an attractive indoor-outdoor living space & allowing for an abundance of natural light.

Pembroke Manor enjoys an exceptional location on Pembroke Road, within walking distance of Ballsbridge, Baggot Street, Grand Canal Dock, and Dublin city centre. The area offers an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, bars, supermarkets, and boutique shops, while nearby Herbert Park provides a wonderful green space for leisure and recreation. The apartment also benefits from excellent public transport links, including numerous Dublin Bus routes and Lansdowne Road DART Station, providing convenient access throughout the city and beyond.

This is an ideal opportunity for first-time buyers, investors, or anyone seeking a superbly presented home in a prime Dublin 4 location, where every conceivable amenity is on the doorstep.


Entrance/ Hallway - 1.03m (3'5") x 1.76m (5'9")

Bedroom - 4.4m (14'5") x 4.61m (15'1")
Spacious space with built-in double bed and storage. French doors leading to private outdoor space.

Kitchen area - 2.04m (6'8") x 2.3m (7'7")
Fitted kitchen floor and wall units with built-in oven and hob.

Bathroom/Shower room - 1.77m (5'10") x 2.21m (7'3")
Walk in shower - with sleek, modern wall and floor tiles. WHB.
